name: sgs/audio
title: SGS Audio
description: Audio player with seven visual styles — from a quiet minimal pill to live spectrum bars, an oscilloscope, and a gradient that pulses to the sound. Reacts to the real audio via the Web Audio API; falls back to a native player with no JavaScript.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent._note: accentColour is the player-brand colour (play button fill, seek thumb, progress arc — CSS var --sgs-audio-accent, style.css:61/86/94/103/107/174, all `background`/`background-image` uses). Mapped to css:background-color via explicit attrMap (Spec 35 vocabulary fix) rather than left as an honest zero-cluster orphan. GRADIENT SIBLING (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout): accentColourGradient added via css:background-image, but style.css only wires background-image:var(--sgs-audio-accent-gradient,none) onto the 3 GENUINE solid `background: var(--sgs-audio-accent...)` paints (play button style.css:61, seek-thumb ::-webkit-slider-thumb :94, seek-thumb ::-moz-range-thumb :103) — deliberately SKIPPED on 3 sites reusing the same --sgs-audio-accent var in a way a flat background-image override would break: the composed progress-track linear-gradient (:86), the composed radial glow gradient (:174, accent is a colour-mix ingredient inside an existing gradient formula), and the focus outline (:107, outline-color cannot take background-image at all). view.js also reads --sgs-audio-accent directly as a canvas fillStyle (waveform bars) and an SVG stroke (radial ring/arc) — unaffected, since the gradient sibling is a SEPARATE custom property only consumed by the 3 new background-image declarations, not a change to --sgs-audio-accent itself. HOVER SIBLING (2026-09-06, FILL closeout): accentColourHover/accentColourHoverGradient scoped ONLY to the play button's own :hover rule (style.css .sgs-audio__play:hover) — the ONE genuinely hoverable target this element paints (a real <button>); the seek-thumb/progress-track/glow/outline/canvas consumers are deliberately left untouched, same discipline as the resting gradient sibling above.

spectrum.label: Spectrum colour
spectrum._note: spectrumColour drives the reactive spectrum/oscilloscope visualiser accent (--sgs-audio-spectrum) — a functional signal colour, not a styled element. Declared via fill cluster + explicit attrMap (Spec 35 vocabulary fix, 2026-08-20), mirroring the accent element above. GRADIENT SIBLING SKIPPED (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout): --sgs-audio-spectrum is read exclusively by view.js as a canvas 2D fillStyle/strokeStyle for the live spectrum-bar / oscilloscope-line drawing (resolveColour() -> concrete rgb, per the file own comment that var() references will not paint on canvas) — never consumed by a CSS background-color rule. A CSS gradient string cannot be assigned as a canvas fillStyle/strokeStyle without constructing a CanvasGradient object from real pixel coordinates, which is a genuine new-design problem (reactive redraw on resize/scroll), not this mechanical background-image-sibling pattern. No block.json/render.php/style.css/edit.js change made for spectrumColour.

accentColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the play button / seek-thumb accent background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over accentColour on those 3 sites only; the composed progress-track/glow gradients and the focus outline keep reading accentColour flat.

accentColourHover.description: Play button background colour on :hover (style.css .sgs-audio__play:hover, colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). The play button's :hover rule previously only animated transform:scale — no colour change existed. Falls back to accentColour, then the theme default, when unset.

accentColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the play button's :hover background via background-image. Non-empty wins over accentColourHover; falls back to accentColourGradient, then none.
